correctness.rationale: The Gaussian transfer formula identifies each block with a scalar multiple of a linear-composition adjoint. Its singular values show all-Schatten membership exactly when all coordinate contractions are strict. Quaternionic coefficient cancellation persists under the deformation. At zero active damping the symbols remain bounded and nondecaying while active composition remains contractive; zero passive damping in higher dimension tensors a nonzero active factor with the identity and is noncompact. The exponential-polynomial argument excludes finite rank.
residual_risks: No optimal quasi-norm formula for the four-term sums is claimed.
